content.text:
TUI parity audit complete. The pedagogy/runtime layer is already shared; the gap is almost entirely the OpenTUI host.

1. Runtime path

- `keating tui` dispatches separately from the classic shell at [src/cli/main.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/cli/main.ts:506).
- It launches the same provider config, session directory, Pi extension, prompts, skills, and system prompt through RPC at [src/runtime/pi.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/runtime/pi.ts:428).
- The extension registers the full deterministic command/tool surface on session start at [src/pi/hyper-teacher/index.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/pi/hyper-teacher/index.ts:353).
- OpenTUI is therefore a presentation host, not a separate tutor implementation: [src/tui/opentui-host.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/opentui-host.ts:17) → [src/tui/host-controller.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/host-controller.ts:96).

2. Highest-impact deficiencies

- Tool failures disappear completely because `tool_execution_end` returns immediately on `isError`: [host-controller.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/host-controller.ts:126). This is the most important correctness/trust problem.
- Rich `ui_document` results are flattened into static cards with no action dispatch, despite actions being defined in [types.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/ui/types.ts:9). Quizzes, goals, decks, scenes, and artifacts are view-only after rendering.
- The RPC client supports state, model selection, thinking level, new sessions, abort, session switching, cloning, forking, export, and command discovery, but the host only calls `prompt`, `followUp`, and `stop`.
- Existing messages are never hydrated. The transcript always begins as a new empty in-memory array at [opentui-host.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/opentui-host.ts:103).
- `/plan`, `/quiz`, `/outputs`, etc. exist but there is no command palette or discoverability, even though RPC exposes `getCommands()`.
- Pi `editor` requests are mapped onto the single-line chat input at [opentui-host.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/opentui-host.ts:155). They also overwrite and discard any draft already in the composer.
- All transcript roles, tool activity, cards, notices, and errors are flattened into one same-color `TextRenderable`. Cards are fixed at 76 columns, so the UI neither adapts well nor visually separates conversation from activity.
- Ctrl+C exits the application; there is no terminal-native “cancel current generation.”
- No terminal analog exists yet for the web’s session browser, model/settings controls, artifact side panel, response comparison, starter prompts, Coming Up view, or live voice/video. Courses and hosted-account surfaces should remain later, explicit terminal adaptations rather than being copied mechanically.

3. Safe implementation slice

I recommend a bounded “OpenTUI learning cockpit” owned only by:

- `src/tui/opentui-host.ts`
- `src/tui/host-controller.ts`
- `src/tui/ui/render.ts`
- new `src/tui/view-model.ts`
- `test/opentui-host.test.ts`
- new `test/tui-view-model.test.ts`

It can deliver:

- Two-pane responsive layout: readable transcript plus compact session/activity rail.
- Model, thinking level, session name, pending count, and busy state in the header.
- Command palette from `getCommands()`.
- Model picker, thinking-level control, new session, and abort shortcuts.
- Existing-message hydration.
- Typed transcript entries with distinct user, assistant, tool, artifact, notice, and error presentation.
- Visible sanitized tool failures.
- Draft-safe modal handling and a real multiline editor.
- Action affordances listed on semantic documents, preparing the next slice for interactive deck/goal/OpenUI actions.

This avoids every dirty web file and does not fork or duplicate pedagogy logic.

4. Validation

Focused baseline passed:

- 28 tests passed across `opentui-host`, `hyperteacher-extension`, and command catalog tests.
- No failures.
- Animation and verification exercised their documented deterministic fallbacks because no OpenAI credential was available.
- Real provider-backed TUI E2E remains gated behind `KEATING_E2E=1`.

Follow-up gates should be:

- `rtk bun test test/opentui-host.test.ts test/tui-view-model.test.ts test/hyperteacher-extension.test.ts test/commands.test.ts`
- `rtk bun run build`
- Manual `keating tui` checks at wide and narrow terminal sizes.
- Provider-backed quiz/dialog/tool-error/abort scenario with `KEATING_E2E=1`.
